fields.name: height
fields.description: The height of the mask. Some models may resize images prior to inference. If resized, this is the size of the resized image.

fields.name: width
fields.description: The width of the mask. Some models may resize images prior to inference. If resized, this is the size of the resized image.

fields.name: depth
fields.description: The depth of the original mask before encoding

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Additional metadata for the segmentation e.g. description of the segmentation, labels and so on...

fields.name: file_ref_segmentation_mask
fields.description: Reference to an external file containing the segmentation mask if the mask is large

fields.name: background
fields.description: The class label for the background. Default is 0.

fields.name: rle
fields.description: A sequence of pairs: class label and the number of pixels for that class label. Example: [0, 199, 1,5, 0, 50,...]

fields.name: class_label
fields.description: The 2D array representing the segmentation mask
